items.name: 蓝晒标本
items.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished, strongly stylized art-direction proposal for a cozy 2D birdwatching and rare-wonders game called "Little Elsewhere". Landscape 16:9, 1920x1080 composition.
Input image 1 is ONLY a reference for the geography and cozy window view: left tree with bird, balcony plants and feeding bowl, broad curved river, far town and snowy mountains. Completely remove ALL existing UI including the entire bottom dark-green debug toolbar. Replace every UI graphic and every text panel. Preserve the environment's general arrangement but restyle its brushwork coherently.
DIRECTION 14: CYANOTYPE HERBARIUM. Exceptionally distinctive real cyanotype contact-print craft: deep Prussian-blue dyed handmade paper, ivory white negative botanical silhouettes, fern fronds and ginkgo leaves, frosted photographic edges, perforated archival tags, pressed flower specimens and fine drawn specimen lines. TWO-COLOR graphic identity with small dusty blue tonal differences; NOT a generic white/blue application skin. Irregular deckled-paper frames, botanical silhouettes form the actual panel borders and controls; folio tabs and stamp shapes instead of ordinary rectangles.
Composition: left roughly 70% is a complete game HUD mockup surrounding the open window landscape, with an artful botanical header titled "Little Elsewhere", small sunshine weather medallion, an unobtrusive observation slip and meaningful tactile "Observe" / "Focus" controls along the lower edge. Center view stays spacious. Right roughly 30% is a tall matching "Field Guide" folio mockup with a beautifully drawn sparrow specimen, archival bird contact-print cards, "Sparrow", "12/50" and a few botanical index tabs. These two views form one harmonious professional game UI concept board. Precise legible short English only, no paragraphs of tiny invented text.
Mood: quiet, collectible, poetic, sophisticated handmade artwork; ivory paper grain and authentic blue sunprint density. Keep scene low saturation and flatter ink/hand-painted treatment, not oily painting. Make the cyanotype material and irregular graphic shapes dominant across the entire interface. No modern SaaS dashboard, no repeated rounded rectangles, no glossy 3D, no neon, no black debug bar, no watermark.
items.inspection: Strong cyanotype print, deckled paper and botanical silhouette interface; reference debug toolbar removed; short English labels legible.

items.name: 月影彩窗
items.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create ONE complete, premium game UI art-direction concept for the cozy birdwatching and rare-wonders game "Little Elsewhere". Landscape 16:9, about 1920x1080 composition.
Reference image is ONLY for the arrangement of the view: a window sill with plants and cup, large left tree and visiting birds, bird feeding bowl, curved river and far town, layered snowy mountains and sky. REMOVE ALL original panels, labels and the entire dark-green bottom developer toolbar. Preserve this landscape geography and the warm small-window premise; redesign every interface shape.
DIRECTION 15: MOONLIT STAINED GLASS. The entire UI is a tender Art Nouveau leaded-glass artwork. Real sinuous curving lead lines, irregular arched panes, moth wings, crescent moon, birds and iris leaves integrated into structural frames; translucent peacock teal, smoky violet, antique cream and restrained amber gold. Rounded rectangles are forbidden: controls are curved glass leaves, medallions, pierced arched silhouettes, flowing stems. Thin brushed dark lead and subtle light passing through colored glass, not shiny computer neon or plastic. Painterly hand-drawn illustration with crisp outlined graphic design and restrained desaturated colors.
Composition: left 70% shows an airy game window with mountains and river visible through an elegant irregular arched glass UI frame. A distinctive illustrated title ribbon integrated with a crescent and moth says "Little Elsewhere". A small weather stained-glass medallion at top, two expressive leaf/petal buttons near the sill read "Observe" and "Focus", and a tiny bird observation seal. Right 30% shows the matching "Field Guide": a tall cathedral-window-inspired bird collection folio, one large sparrow drawn as a glass-and-ink specimen in an arched panel, 3 smaller collected bird glass cameos and a moon-shaped "12/50" counter. Short English text only: "Little Elsewhere", "Field Guide", "Sparrow", "Observe", "Focus", "12/50". No paragraphs or extra tiny writing.
The scene can be softly unified into a moonlit blue-green hand-painted illustration, but keep the main geographic view recognizable. This is a cohesive professional UI concept board, not two random illustrations. Strong illustrative craft in EVERY UI component. Calm, magical, readable, collectible. No dashboard, no generic theme swap, no oil-slick impasto, no saturated neon, no photographic 3D, no developer toolbar or watermark.
items.inspection: Strong leaded glass arches, moth/moon/iris structure and curved leaf controls; reference debug toolbar removed; labels legible.

items.name: 木偶窗剧场
items.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create ONE complete, boldly stylized game UI art-direction proposal for "Little Elsewhere", a cozy window-view birdwatching and rare-wonders game. Landscape 16:9 about 1920x1080.
Reference image is ONLY for geography: view outward from a small balcony window with cup, plant pots and bird bowl; large tree on the left; winding river, opposite town, snow mountains. Keep that scenic arrangement recognizable but entirely redraw it in the new artistic medium. REMOVE all old UI, text panels and the entire bottom dark-green developer toolbar.
DIRECTION 16: TINY WOODEN THEATRE. A handcrafted two-dimensional toy theatre / painted woodblock diorama interface, with naive flat gouache pigments, visible carved wood grain, deliberately irregular cut-out edges, decorative wood birds and sun/moon discs, a curved proscenium arch, painted scalloped curtain trim, wooden slide rails, little ticket levers and scalloped admission stubs as controls. Primary colors are cream, muted brick-red, forest green and honey wood; only a few ink outlines. All interface shapes feel cut by hand and assembled as a little puppet stage, not sleek beveled video-game boxes. NO glossy 3D or photorealism. Flat playful storybook graphic art with convincing woodcut/print textures.
Composition: left around 70% is a generous playable scenic window framed as a toy stage. A carved bird crest and hand-painted marquee say "Little Elsewhere". Tiny hanging weather discs sit near the top; below the view, physical sliding wooden tickets labelled "Observe" and "Focus" serve as the main controls, with an illustrated sparrow ticket showing "12/50". Right around 30% is a matching "Field Guide" made like a miniature wooden puppet cabinet with a large flat-painted sparrow specimen, scalloped tickets or sliding specimen drawers with 3 different bird silhouettes, a little ticket printed "Sparrow", and a pull-out card motif. Keep the cabinet fun, handmade and collectible. The stage and cabinet are one coherent professional UI concept board, with plenty of scenic breathing space.
Use only concise legible English labels "Little Elsewhere", "Field Guide", "Sparrow", "Observe", "Focus", "12/50". Make the painted wood, flat folk illustration and toy-theatre silhouettes strongly dominant; do not merely frame the existing screenshot. Avoid ordinary rounded rectangle panels, SaaS dashboard, oil painting, over-saturated rainbow colors, neon, realistic shiny plastic, tiny invented text, watermark or developer controls.
items.inspection: Strong folk-painted wood theatre, scalloped curtain and ticket levers with bird cabinet; reference debug toolbar removed; labels legible.
